# FLX-3670: a Simulation declares forecasts without a sweep long enough for their interval

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A forecast is the median of the runs of spec.sweep, and its interval runs between the values of rank a and R + 1 - a, with a the largest whole number not above R (1 - c) / 2. A Simulation with no sweep, or one whose runs R leave a below 1 (fewer than 20 runs at 0.9), cannot give an interval at its confidence c.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3670
```
